settings.title: the free speaker build
settings.body: A complete STEM project at no cost — students design and build a working bamboo speaker, start to finish.

settings.title: no engineering background needed
settings.body: Teachers run it whether or not they've held a saw. Everything to deliver it is provided; you bring the class.

settings.title: build up to OCN accreditation
settings.body: When students want more, the free build grows into an OCN London accredited programme — real coursework with portfolio evidence.

settings.title: help finding the funding
settings.body: The Speaker is free so you can prove it works before you ask for a budget — and we help schools find funding routes for the paid programmes.

settings.hero_lede: Hands-on STEM and vocational learning through building real bamboo bikes — free taster builds to OCN London Level 2 accredited courses, for schools, colleges, councils and youth services. Every route starts with a conversation.
settings.paths_title: one craft, built for your setting.

settings.stories_title: the same course, in very different rooms.
settings.stories_lede: Schools, universities, youth clubs and community halls — real deliveries, one method.
settings.prog_lede: Start with the free Speaker build. Climb to accredited frame builds, 3D-printed lugs and e-mobility — priced by quote. Not every session needs a workshop, either — we also run design sprints and challenge sessions for universities, colleges and employability cohorts.
